milestones.title: M0 Foundations and phase 0 on the board
milestones.description: WP0 + WP1. Phase 0 reproduced on the X-S32Z27X-DC; contracts and the E2E threat table pass in CI.

milestones.title: M1 Safety floor - D1
milestones.description: WP2 + WP3, design phase 1 (autonomous fallback). HPC: H1 H7 H2 H5. Exit: demo D1, HPC loss and island blindness on the bench, B4 within 70 ms.

milestones.title: M2 Obstacle-aware bounded stop
milestones.description: WP4 (without I8) + WP5, design phase 3 and the phase-2 fallback tier. Exit: in-lane bounded stop after HPC loss, shortened for obstacles.

milestones.title: M3 Minimal pull-over island - D3
milestones.description: WP7, design phase 4. HPC: H8. Exit: demo D3, the golf cart pulls over when the HPC does not return.

milestones.title: M4 Lane hold after HPC loss - D2
milestones.description: WP6 (B2). HPC: H6 H3. Exit: demo D2, the island holds the lane and hands back to the HPC; D3 re-run via the B2-to-B3 fork.

milestones.title: M5 Guardian role and ODD degradation - D4
milestones.description: I8 + WP8, design phases 2 (complete) and 5. HPC: H4. Exit: demo D4, degraded visibility, ODD switch demanded and verified.

milestones.title: M6 Local control - D5
milestones.description: WP9 (B6; B5 stubs). Exit: demo D5, wired joystick drives the stopped cart off the road. Can start after M1.

milestones.title: M7 Pilot readiness
milestones.description: WP10 (N11 event recorder, N20 optional). Exit: audit step met; required before any pilot.
